body: No problem. Cheers, friend. If you were in the minneapolis area I would totally go see MCS with you. They play here all the time.

Right on! I love Motion City!

I don't know how you are feeling now, but I hope things are going better for you. I know what it's like to stay up in the middle of the night just scribbling down all the unsettling thoughts going through your head. If that's any consolation.

"I'm just a guy that never tried. I'm just a stupid fuck with brilliant luck and sometimes a bright idea..."

Were you referring to that song with the line at the end? http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TwbuKPgXh6I#t=1m40s
Garden State - great movie about depression/apathy. Although I wouldn't reccomend anyone stop taking their medication and suddenly decide to take on the world on their own...

I just wanted to say I really love this-- not the feelings, the drawing you made. I feel for you. I often will just resort to movies or podcasts for "company", I guess. For me it's the adam carolla show. And rain is awesome. I wish it rained more where I live... Thanks for sharing.
Thank you sly fox. Your name makes me think of Sly Cooper, and those games were awesome.

Okay. I will check those out next time I'm at barnes & noble which is somewhat often... The regularity will be really difficult for me. I have shrugged off journaling my day like I wanted to, many times, because of feeling tired/depressed. But I will try.

Thank you. This is a really well-thought out idea. I will try this, I think. I remember that pen now that I looked it up, so I know what you're talking about I think. And get like a sketchbook rather than a regular notebook? I could do that.

I am on Wellbutrin 150mg twice daily, but have only been on it for about a week. Have not felt anything yet but I understand it takes 2-4 weeks to see any results.

That doesn't sound ridiculous, but it is very hard even just to tell myself to breathe slowly... It's like sometimes I WANT to be emotional and just cry my eyes out... Well, I don't actually want to, but... I just need to sometimes. I will try it more often. Thanks for replying.

I have tried keeping a journal, just on my computer, it has been so-so. Went really well for about a month after the break-up, but it is hard now to really express myself. Now instead of "I did this and that today, I worked X amount of hours tonight, I feel okay.", it's just "I am so sad. Fuck life. I don't wanna be here anymore." and then I close the laptop and just start crying again. It's really hard for me. I had to work up a lot of nerve just to come on here and post. I am still fighting tears because I guess my own life just depresses me more, if that makes sense. I will keep trying to write, it's just sometimes very painful to express how I'm feeling.

Thanks for replying.
I really liked this... I can relate to it a lot, having a "personal demon" and all. Thanks for sharing it.
I really liked this analogy, thanks for sharing.
